constructive_value_witness.bb_cap: Check after every limp and fold to every SB opening raise; SB fold pays -1/2, checked limp pays u < 1, raise pays +1.
constructive_value_witness.sb_guarantee: Open shove for every own AA hand; fold pays +1, call pays 3u > 1 for every compatible pair.
constructive_value_witness.scope: Constructive exact value of the fixed AA/KK finite preflop/checkdown game, not an unrestricted or arbitrary-range equilibrium.
